access.account_hacked_or_locked.title: Account hacked and playlists lost
access.account_hacked_or_locked.description: A user reports their account was hacked and they cannot recover playlists they set up.

access.logged_out.title: Unexpectedly logged out and cannot sign back in
access.logged_out.description: Users are logged out automatically and then get errors when trying to log back in with their phone number.

access.login_failure.title: Unable to log in to the app
access.login_failure.description: Users cannot log in, reporting rejected passwords, false no-internet messages, token errors, and repeated number verification prompts.
access.login_failure.suggested_split: Login failures with connection or token errors vs. ads complaints

billing.other.title: Repeated pressure to join premium
billing.other.description: A user says they were asked to join premium far too many times.

billing.plans_family_student.title: Forced premium trial and lost features
billing.plans_family_student.description: Users feel forced into a premium trial and report features such as Canvas no longer available despite paying for premium.
billing.plans_family_student.suggested_split: Forced premium trial vs. premium features missing after update

billing.premium_only_controls.title: Core playback controls locked behind premium
billing.premium_only_controls.description: After an update, features such as shuffle, next track, and ordered playback require a premium subscription.

billing.price.title: Music subscription charges feel too high
billing.price.description: A user finds the charges for listening to music too high.

billing.subscription_activation.title: Premium purchase or activation fails
billing.subscription_activation.description: Users cannot buy or activate premium, or still see a paused subscription screen after paying.

catalog.lyrics.title: Song lyrics fail to load or appear
catalog.lyrics.description: Lyrics do not load for some songs, even after refreshing or updating the app.

catalog.missing_or_removed_content.title: Songs missing or removed from catalog
catalog.missing_or_removed_content.description: Users report that many songs or collaboration streams are missing or removed, and that limited previews are offered instead of full tracks.
catalog.missing_or_removed_content.suggested_split: Removed songs and collab streams vs. only 30-second previews available

catalog.other.title: Specific library and Wrap features not loading
catalog.other.description: Users report that Liked Songs and Spotify Wrap 2022 fail to open or display.
catalog.other.suggested_split: Liked Songs and Wrap not opening

catalog.recommendations.title: Recommendations repetitive and unwanted despite settings
catalog.recommendations.description: Users say recommendations keep appearing and repeat the same songs even after turning them off, and the DJ feature plays stale selections.
catalog.recommendations.suggested_split: Recommendations ignore off settings and DJ repeats songs

downloads.download_failure.title: Downloads stall or never start
downloads.download_failure.description: Users report downloads getting stuck in the background or not starting at all.

downloads.downloads_disappear.title: Downloaded content vanished unexpectedly
downloads.downloads_disappear.description: A premium user reports all downloaded content is gone and questions the value of the subscription.

downloads.offline_mode.title: Offline mode fails and deletes downloads
downloads.offline_mode.description: Users report offline mode not working and downloads deleted when moving storage.
downloads.offline_mode.suggested_split: Offline mode not working vs downloads deleted on storage move

downloads.storage.title: App consumes excessive data and storage
downloads.storage.description: A user says the app wastes data and phone storage.

other.boycott_political.title: Users boycott app over political stance
other.boycott_political.description: Users uninstall or boycott the app over Sweden and Quran burning and related political objections.

other.general_criticism.title: Generic negative sentiment without specific problem
other.general_criticism.description: Reviews express general dislike or insults toward the app without naming a concrete defect.

playback.audio_quality.title: Poor audio quality and noise during playback
playback.audio_quality.description: Users report noise, low volume, and music adjustment not working properly.

playback.connection_errors.title: False no-internet errors on working connections
playback.connection_errors.description: Users see no-internet messages or failed playback even when Wi-Fi or mobile data works fine.
playback.connection_errors.suggested_split: Wi-Fi and mobile data connection failures vs missing Bollywood songs

playback.crashes_or_wont_open.title: App crashes or freezes on launch
playback.crashes_or_wont_open.description: Users report the app crashing, getting stuck on the loading screen, or shutting down during playback, especially after a recent update.

playback.device_connectivity.title: Trouble connecting to other devices
playback.device_connectivity.description: Users cannot cast or connect playback to other devices or voice assistants, and playback fails or plays unexpected songs instead.
playback.device_connectivity.suggested_split: Voice assistant and casting playback failures

playback.lag_or_slow.title: Podcasts lag during playback
playback.lag_or_slow.description: A premium subscriber reports podcasts suddenly lagging, which they find unacceptable.

playback.other.title: Miscellaneous playback and content problems
playback.other.description: Users report alarms not connecting, empty app content, inappropriate song selection, shuffle playing only a few songs, and inability to switch between video and audio podcasts.
playback.other.suggested_split: Shuffle and podcast mode switching problems

playback.stops_or_skips.title: Playback randomly stops or fails to start tracks
playback.stops_or_skips.description: Songs and podcasts pause or stop unexpectedly, sometimes with full connectivity, and some liked tracks fail to play when selected.
playback.stops_or_skips.suggested_split: Liked tracks failing to play versus random mid-playback pauses

usability.ads.title: Excessive and unskippable advertisements
usability.ads.description: Users say ads are too frequent, play back-to-back, include unskippable video, and interrupt music listening.

usability.controls.title: Limited skip and repeat controls
usability.controls.description: Users cannot skip to random songs in a playlist on mobile and report that skip and repeat options were removed after an update.

usability.navigation_layout.title: Hard to navigate and find content
usability.navigation_layout.description: Users find the app difficult to navigate, with liked songs opening wrong tracks or demos, and say updates make it less user friendly, especially for older users.

usability.other.title: General dissatisfaction and unwanted autostart
usability.other.description: Users call the app poor even with premium and report it starts automatically despite disabled permissions.
usability.other.suggested_split: App starts automatically despite disabled permissions

usability.redesign_update.title: Unwelcome recent redesign and update changes
usability.redesign_update.description: Users dislike the recent update's new lyrics font, replaced heart icon, removed lyrics and queue features, and reduced seek ability, calling it worse than before.
usability.redesign_update.suggested_split: Missing lyrics and queue features versus visual design changes

usability.shuffle_autoplay.title: Shuffle forced and autoplay overriding playback choices
usability.shuffle_autoplay.description: Users report that shuffle is forced or defaulted on, limiting skips and loop options and causing unrequested songs to play.
